fields.description: Yachtside Marina Residences is a three-tower apartment development at Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. It faces a planned marina and waterfront promenade. One- and two-bedroom layouts include balcony and yard variants; Tower A is identified as the fully furnished collection.

overview: Yard homes and balcony homes have different outdoor arrangements. Compare enclosed space separately from the saleable total and inspect the precise unit plan before choosing a residence.
research.locationNote: In the marina district of Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Mooring and access depend on final arrangements; a private berth is not assumed to be included in an apartment.
research.priceNote: The developer displays AED 1.42m subject to inventory availability. Property Finder reports a launch reference of AED 1.417m, rounded to 1.4m. The official FAQ retains an approximate 1.3m statement; obtain a dated quote for an actual unit.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder gives 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% handover. These secondary aggregate stages are not a current signed payment calendar.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports June 2029, displayed as Q2 2029. Its first-of-month date is not adopted as a developer contractual commitment.

facts.label: Furnishing scope
facts.value: The official page identifies Tower A as fully furnished. The three-tower site plan does not extend that promise to every apartment.

unresolved: Primary payment/completion documents, current stock, parking, service charges and mooring terms were not retrieved.
Some printed component sums differ by 0.01 sq ft through rounding; published totals are retained. Tower A furnishing does not automatically extend to every tower. Images remain illustrative.
